st: Ski holidays, boyfriends turned into candles and the magic of Christmas

sec.t: ff.43.1 Is skiing disappearing with the snow?
sec.p: I grew up surrounded by skiers in Northern Italy. For me, winter and Christmas mean races, skis on my feet and the smell of ski wax.
You can only ski if there's snow, obviously. Here it is in works of art: The Cultural Tutor on Twitter really has a thread for everything.
Now let's look at some last-minute art and design gifts.

sec.t: ff.43.4 This year's best Christmas ads
sec.p: ItsNiceThat collected this year's best Christmas ads. A classic.
